QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Kerning Square Shopping Center
QuestInfo.0:
Kerning City Subway's favorite employee, Blake, has dreams of becoming the world's greatest pop star... but he needs your help! Gather up support from the people of Kerning Square Shopping Center to put on the show of a lifetime, and make Blake's dream a reality.



- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 35-40

- #eRoute#n: Take the Kerning City Subway
